billing.target_label: Who is the invoice made out to?
billing.split_none_example: B1 Amsterdam's general cleaning and window cleaning for the month go on one invoice together.
billing.split_department_work_type: A separate invoice per department and work type
billing.split_department_work_type_examp: B1 Amsterdam's general cleaning and window cleaning become two invoices.
billing.this_run_only: Applies to this run only. The customer's saved setting is not changed.
nothing.no_extra_work: No extra work for this customer in this period.
nothing.none_finished_one: {{count}} extra work, but it is not finished yet — an invoice needs a closed ticket.
nothing.none_finished_other: {{count}} extra works, none of them finished yet — an invoice needs a closed ticket.
nothing.all_invoiced_one: Everything finished has already been invoiced ({{count}} extra work).
nothing.all_invoiced_other: Everything finished has already been invoiced ({{count}} extra works).
nothing.not_in_period: {{count}} finished, but their invoice date falls in a later period.
nothing.heading: Nothing to invoice
created_by.label: Created by
due.draft_hint: A draft can still be changed. The invoice number is given when you send.
road.due_title: Finished work that is not on an invoice yet
road.due_body: One row per customer. “Make a draft” gathers that customer's finished extra work and the contract's fixed period into a draft you can still change.
road.due_empty_title: No customers with a billing schedule.
road.due_empty_body: Set an invoice day on the customer; finished extra work then appears here by itself as “to invoice”.
road.drafts_body: A draft has no number yet and every line can still be changed or removed. “Issue” means “I checked it”: the lines freeze. The number comes at Send.
road.drafts_empty_body: A draft appears when you press Make a draft on finished work (step 1), or from a contract period.
road.issued_title: Issued — checked, not yet with the customer
road.issued_body: Frozen, no number yet. “Send” gives the invoice its number and delivers the PDF to the customer's billing address. A mistake after this point is fixed with a credit note, not by editing.
road.issued_empty_body: An invoice appears here once you check and issue a draft (step 2).
road.sent_body: Numbered and delivered. Nothing to do here unless something was wrong: a credit note reverses an invoice and shows next to it.
road.sent_empty_body: An invoice arrives here when you send it (step 3); only then does the customer see it, with its final number.
road.start_due: {{count}} customers have finished work waiting for an invoice — {{total}} in total. {{name}} bills on {{day}} and is due now.
road.start_issued: {{count}} checked invoices are waiting to be sent.
road.made_body: Nothing is sent. Next: open the draft and check the lines, then issue it.
road.no_day_set: No billing day set — bills when you say
road.start_no_day: {{name}} has {{total}} finished and no billing day yet — nothing picks it up until you set one or make the draft yourself.
road.day_set_body: Nothing is invoiced yet — their finished work now shows when it is due, and the daily run picks them up on their day.
road.at_risk_review_named_one: Reported done, waiting for {{names}}'s check — {{count}} day
road.at_risk_review_named_other: Reported done, waiting for {{names}}'s check — {{count}} days
road.at_risk_review_one: Reported done, waiting for the manager's check — {{count}} day
road.at_risk_review_other: Reported done, waiting for the manager's check — {{count}} days
road.at_risk_done_unmoved_one: Reported done, not checked yet — {{count}} day
road.at_risk_done_unmoved_other: Reported done, not checked yet — {{count}} days
road.at_risk_converted: Converted to extra work — this one stopped on {{date}}
road.at_risk_crew_unable: The crew could not finish and nobody was reassigned — since {{date}}
road.at_risk_past_deadline_one: Past its deadline, still in progress — {{count}} day
road.at_risk_past_deadline_other: Past its deadline, still in progress — {{count}} days
road.at_risk_not_planned: Not planned yet — its day was {{date}}
road.at_risk_foot_one: {{count}} running job will not reach this month's invoices
road.at_risk_foot_other: {{count}} running jobs will not reach this month's invoices
how.1: Make a draft gathers a customer's finished work into a draft you can still change — nothing is sent.
how.2: Issue freezes the lines — the invoice still has no number.
how.3: Send gives the number and emails the PDF; nothing reaches the customer before this.
how.4: A credit note reverses a sent invoice, next to it — the original never changes.
how.5: Preview shows the PDF at any step, without storing anything.
road.what_generate: Makes a draft you can still change or delete. Nothing is sent.
road.what_issue: Freezes the lines; the number comes at Send.
road.what_send: Gives the invoice its number and emails the PDF — the first thing the customer sees.
